order.name: scheduler-2
order.delta: reactor-1 plus the two existing meridian-07 patches only
order.reason: r1 diagnostic reduced proxy cores by about 0.09 and peak threads from 1331 to 682; removes terrain-timer stacks and possible thread-local allocator residency
order.limit: existing r1 overall P95 5.121833 ms is over the strict line and is not qualifying; no RSS improvement inferred from thread count

order.name: scheduler-2-writev64
order.reason: profile attributes 11.46 percent of Running CPU to allocations/copies and 39.88 percent to socket calls; removes one descriptor Vec per write_vectored attempt and increases macOS descriptor fanout from 16 to 64
order.limit: not all per-packet allocation; payload/frame buffers and the read/write ready-set drain Vec allocations remain

order.name: zone16m60-r1
order.delta: one separately named patch on the latency-qualified scheduler base, with or without writev64 as selected before the cell
order.reason: native E24 malloc residency grew with RSS while allocated bytes and stack residency fell; directly tests allocator free-page return if the earlier candidates leave growth
order.limit: synchronous allocator work and allocator locks may hurt the tail; goal bytes are best effort, not a duration or byte-work cap
